list.snippet: CPT code 93015: Cardiovascular stress test using maximal or submaximal treadmill or bicycle exercise, continuous electrocardiographic monitoring, and/or pharmacological stress; with supervision, interpretation, and report.

text_blocks.snippet: This code encompasses the entire stress test procedure, including:
Physician supervision, Electrocardiographic (ECG) monitoring, and Interpretation and report.

It's important to note that other CPT codes may be used depending on the specific components of the stress test performed. For example, if only the ECG monitoring is done, code 93017 may be appropriate.
